description: This file contains unit tests for the OnKeyWordHelper class, verifying its behavior in handling key inputs and matching specific keyword sequences within the context of an Android keyboard application.

classes.name: OnKeyWordHelperTest
classes.description: Test class for OnKeyWordHelper, containing multiple test cases to verify keyword matching logic.

methods.name: testHandlesNullKey
methods.description: Tests that the helper correctly handles a null key input.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies the helper's behavior when the correct sequence of characters is input, ensuring it triggers show logic at the right point.

methods.name: testPathReset
methods.description: Checks that the helper resets its internal state after sequence input, and does not show until the full sequence is matched.

methods.name: testPathResetWithSameStart
methods.description: Ensures that the helper correctly resets and matches the sequence when the start character is repeated.
